fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Others Applicants under the age of 18 shall submit relevant documents of entrusted legal guardians in China. and the certification document of birth certificate by Chinese embassy,the family relationship certificate by Chinese embassy shall be provided additionally. 2. Other supplementary documents Scanned copied of Chinese visa or residence permit pages obtained in recent two years.And the scanning copy of the page of China's exit and entry seals(for those who have come to China within two years). * 3. Copies of the HSK and HSKK certificate * 4. Physical examination record for foreigner students need to download, fill it and then upload it. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity). * 6. Six photos of two-inch Six photos of two-inch(35MM*45MM)bear headed,formal dress with white background. * 7. Senior High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 8. Senior High school academic transcript academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Senior high school diploma,non-Chinese.Students with no basic knowledge of Chinese language can apply to the Chinese major.Students with basic knowledge of Chinese language can enroll as transfer students.Students with HSK 4 can apply for the second year.Students with HSK 4(180 or morel) and HSKK intermediate can apply for the first year of Chinese International Education. Students who want to study in other departments(besides SCS)should have HSK 5 195 or more. Applicants under the age of 18 shall submit relevat ducuments of entrusted legal guardians in China. After obtaining the X1 visa,it is necessary to obtain the certification documents of birth certificate at the Chinese Embassy abroad.If there is no parental information on the birth certificate,the family relationship certificate certified by the Chinese Embassy shall be prvided, and the students can only enter the school after submitting them at the time of enrollment. Note: The cost of one academic year (undergraduate course) is 21800 yuan. The fee includes registration fee, tuition fee and miscellaneous fee, which shall be paid at one time upon enrollment.
